name: Roaming Legendary

encounters.name: Latios
encounters.notes: If you answer "blue" about the TV report after the Hall of Fame

encounters.name: Latias
encounters.notes: If you answer "red" about the TV report after the Hall of Fame

notes: After you enter the Hall of Fame, your mom asks what color the Pokémon on the TV was. Your answer decides whether Latias (red) or Latios (blue) roams Hoenn's routes.
